_about: SINGLE-TRANSLATION SHELF: the third shelf of one-off English translations of fiction, plays and verse, mostly from the 1920s: Luo Guanzhong's Romance of the Three Kingdoms (Brewitt-Taylor, 1925), Remarque's All Quiet on the Western Front (Wheen, 1929), Hesse's Steppenwolf (Creighton, 1929), Rølvaag's Giants in the Earth (1927), Thomas Mann's Death in Venice (Kenneth Burke, 1925), Čapek's Krakatit, Kivi's Seven Brothers, Mauriac's Thérèse and The Kiss to the Leper, Undset's The Bridal Wreath, Couperus's Eline Vere, Multatuli's Max Havelaar, Rolland's Annette and Sylvie, Merezhkovsky's Akhnaton, Morand, Natsume's Unhuman Tour, Tanizaki, Bettauer's The City Without Jews, Norbert Jacques's Dr. Mabuse, Leroux, Rousseau's Eloisa (Kenrick, 1761), Kotzebue's Virgin of the Sun, Nodier's Bibliomaniac, George Sand, Auerbach's Little Barefoot, Andreyev's plays, Hauptmann, Hebbel's Three Plays, D'Annunzio's Daughter of Jorio, Lope de Vega's New Art of Writing Plays, Goethe and Schiller's Xenions, Michelangelo's sonnets (Newell), Petrarch (Agnes Tobin), Shevchenko's Kobzar, Hálek, the Prem Sagur, Mary of Nimmegen, the Táin (Mary Hutton), Pearse's collected works, Louÿs's Songs of Bilitis, Swedish, French, Costa Rican and Arabian tales, and Voynich's The Humour of Russia. Each title gates on its own translator (_surname_by_slug). US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 44); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
